doc.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29

title: Just a Closer Walk With Thee and playing it with Percy
summary: The men talk about the hymn that draws requests for singing, and Jim praises Percy's key and harmony on it.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: As you were talking about just close to Walk with Dee, that number would never play out. I don't believe it would, because a lot of people likes it.

See, that's how you tell you, we go out there and play that number. But people, they want to hear someone sing it. But I can't sing it, because I ain't got no voice, and I don't talk too plain. And I ain't got to mess myself up with, but I can play my trombone.

Since you mentioned close to Walk with Dee, you know who I love to play close to Walk with Dee with? This man there. Poes is going to play. This man put close to Walk with Dee with? Just a minute. Let him talk to him. Yeah, I'm going to answer him. No, actually, listen. No, I'm waiting. Poes is going to tell you something about what happened. It was no sound of song. Yeah, well, he's right. Poes is going to know this man to play. That's, that's any time. He's going to know this one.

Just a minute. What I'm going to say is this. This man, put close to Walk with Dee with. I'm going to tell you who I love to play close to Walk with Dee with. This man there. Poes is going to play. This man put close to Walk with Dee with. Just a minute. Poes is going to know this man to play. That's any time. He's going to know this one. What I'm going to say is this. The proper tempo and his funeral.

This man, play is close to Walk with Dee. I think he puts it in the right key ever or ever was written in music. Good word. Because the reason I said that is more harmony where he plays that than anybody else I ever play with in my life. If you don't do it, you can do it.
If you don't do it, I'm going to play it with him.
You can know Poe Dee's style. Poe is a brass band. You talk about a brass band. I'm not saying that because he's here.
